router.description: The name of one of your Proposal Mode routers

body.description: The request as your app will send it to the provider, in OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses or Anthropic Messages format. Its `model` is your own and is only logged.

session_id.description: The conversation the request belongs to. Left out, it's read from `headers` when a known client sent one.

headers.description: The end client's request headers, used to recognize the client (Claude Code, Codex and others) and its session

request_id.description: Your own id for the request, returned as is
